thread:
nina.h: Quick proposal: run a 72h microexperiment called "Starter Credit Surge". Goal = benchmark short-term prompt engagement. Keep assets minimal: 1 short email, 2 socials, tiny landing.

omar.r: Nice. What's the credit split?

nina.h: Two variants: 25 credits (low touch) vs 100 credits (high touch). 50/50 split; include a control of organic signups for baseline. Measure 24h prompt_run_rate and prompt_save_rate.

kelly.s: Landing must be 1-click auth + preloaded 3 starter prompts. Add ?src=credit-surge to CTAs so Sales can see it. Short demo GIF please.

ops-bot: Ops checklist: add utm_campaign=credit_surge, create LD flag credit_surge_v1, map hubspot.lead_source=credit_surge. Add event hooks: claim_credit, prompt_run, prompt_save. ETA EOD for flag.

growth-bot: Include eval run for templates: https://internal/evals/credit-surge-v1. Also add a small survey on success toast (1 checkbox: why saved).

omar.r: Draft email subject A/B: A) "Try 100 free credits to ship your first prompt" B) "Start with 25 credits 1 try a starter prompt". Keep CTA: Claim credits.

nina.h: Hypothesis: 100 credits will spike immediate runs but may dilute long-term paid conversion. We'll report daily for 3 days then 7-day wrap. Owners: Kelly (creatives + landing), Omar (copy + social), Ops-bot (flags), Nina (experiment owner + report).

kelly.s: I'll drop a 4-frame GIF + landing mock in Drive by 2pm PT. Omar, ping me for copy edits.

omar.r: Will do. Launch soft Thursday internal, public Friday 10am PT. If we see strong CTR + run rates, we scale the next week.

nina.h: Thanks team — sync 9am tomorrow for final sign-offs :rocket:
